p.n: 준비하다 means to have the money ready; 마련하다 means to come up with or raise the money.

p.n: 숫자 means the digit symbols, not a label number like a phone number.

explain_en: Use this when giving directions. Use 으로 after a consonant, and 로 after a vowel or ㄹ: 지하철역으로, 출구로, 이 길로. 'N에 가세요' only names the place you arrive at, while 'N(으)로 가세요' also shows the direction you head in.
